properties.content: Question: new york std code Answer: New York City uses several area codes, including 212, 718, 347, 917, 646, 929, and 332. Area code 212 was the original for all of NYC but is now primarily for Manhattan. Area code 718 covers Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island, and the Bronx. Area codes 347, 917, 646, 929, and 332 are overlays, meaning they cover the same geographic area as the original codes, according to RingCentral. Here's a more detailed breakdown:: - 212: Originally for all of New York City, now primarily for Manhattan. - 718: Covers Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island, and the Bronx. - 347: Overlay for 718, serving the same boroughs. - 917: Overlay for 212 and 718, serving all five boroughs. - 646: Overlay for 212 and 917, primarily for cell phones and pagers. - 929: Overlay for 718, serving the same boroughs. - 332: Overlay for 212, serving Manhattan. Essentially, if you're calling from New York City, you might encounter any of these area codes depending on the specific location and service.
